hypothesis: Run-2 board execution of the workload registered in spec/r41/chat/s2-qwen-chat-v3-q35.json passes its explicit numerical and structural checks on the approved 100 MHz image.
competing_explanations: the run-2 image, its striped HBM layout, or its four-context DP profile changes behavior
a workload fails, falls back, times out, or is omitted from its registered checks
the card identity or clock changes during the run
expected_counter_changes: real prefill/decode launches change completion and memory-port traffic counters; the run records the observed deltas without a predetermined traffic or performance target
after the first decode graph is compiled, subsequent decode steps of a prompt add no graphs and perform no host reads
the persistent-session repeat records its graph count, code-store evictions and bitwise logit comparison; a mismatch is recorded as a failure
teacher-forced comparisons, failures and timeouts are recorded rather than assumed to pass
the chat-quality step records every prompt's answer, its scores against the archived CPU answers and its decode rate; a failed score is recorded as a failure
expected_observations: the registered workload completes with its numerical and structural checks passing on run-2
the experiment records the observed image, clock, software tree and raw results

identity.timing_boundary: wall time of each actual model call in the chat report; compilation is included in the first prefill/decode calls and is not hidden
identity.cache_state: fresh process and session per step; experiment-local Triton/Inductor/extension caches under {out}/caches

registration.source_scope: frozen image source separately verified; runtime tree recorded by experiment.py
inherited_expected_observations: each chat report records the actual prefill/decode calls, graph counts, host transfers, code-store evictions and teacher-forced comparisons
no result is inferred if a step fails or the execution budget expires

inherited_registration.contract: R41 chat/generation driver; not a claim of Stage 2 acceptance
inherited_registration.inputs: {home}/r41s2_fp8_inputs (pinned HF snapshots and snapview; CPU reference is generated directly by chat.py)
inherited_registration.settings: default TNCA compiler/runtime settings; only the platform identity is selected (TNCA_BACKEND, TNCA_BACKEND_ARGS, TNCA_PROFILE matching the loaded image, clock evidence, deadlines and host timeouts)

registration.scope: Run-2 full-checkpoint chat using device-side feedback, graph-preserving evidence capture, grouped short prefill tails, and a separately recorded dummy decode warmup; quality prompts, references and scoring remain unchanged. Each step has its own budget.
